column1: # core-units.tsv — which unit sessions use each part of docs/core.md (issue #464, ADR-0032)
# The input of scripts/skills/gen-skill-bodies.sh for the unit command bodies
# skills/cycle-u1 … skills/cycle-u7: a unit's body carries, from the core, the
# parts whose entry names that unit or `all`. The grounds of each entry are in
# the pull request that sets it. A line with no tab is a comment; an entry's
#   scope    a heading path: each step a heading's leading text, steps joined
#   prefix   empty: the whole heading section. Otherwise every block of the
#            scope whose first line starts with it — a paragraph, a bullet, a
#            table row, a line of a fenced block (with its indented lines)
#   units    `all`, unit names (U1 … U7, space-separated), or `split`: the
#            section is classified by part, and every block in it needs an
#            entry that matches it — a prefix entry matches every block of
#            its scope that starts with the prefix (`|`: every table row)
# The generator fails on a part of the core no entry classifies, a block two
# entries match, and an entry that matches nothing.
